message.content: {"verdict":"BLOCK","cited_clauses":[1],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The invoice includes a non-day charge that is not payable under the agreement's day-rate terms.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Non-day line items (expenses or fees): Expedite and setup fee 900 USDC.\" Invoice: \"Expedite and setup fee                       1 item × 900.00 = 900.00\""},{"clause":1,"finding":"Only the 10 billed days at the agreed rate fit the contract terms; the invoice total also includes the extra fee, so the full invoice total cannot be paid now.","evidence_quote":"AGREEMENT: \"Agreed day rate: 300 USDC; cap 12 days per month\" and FACTS: \"Days billed: 10, within the 12-day monthly cap.\" \"Day rate billed does not exceed the agreed 300 USDC.\" FACTS: \"Invoice total: 3900 USDC\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":true}
